scope: Read-only review artifact. No approved smoke source, provider request, model wiring, trial population or execution authority is changed.
objective: Determine whether local coaching supports the same or better next-take practice outcome than Gemini on identical evidence.
currentEvidence: No current-campaign paired local/Gemini outputs or quality winner. Six synthetic inputs x three trials are six input clusters, not eighteen independent inputs.

comparisonArms.productAsConfigured: Compare exact shipped/prepared product requests, preserving and reporting their differences. This measures configurations, not isolated model ability.
comparisonArms.controlledModel: A separate prospective comparison must freeze equivalent evidence, instruction content, output contract, generation constraints and full serialized request manifests. Numeric temperature matching alone does not make engines/templates equivalent. No new controlled run authorized.
comparisonArms.sourceBoundFairnessFinding: Llama00ece retains extra safety-system instruction, temperature0 and max_tokens256. Gemini main10904766 source sets prompt contents and MIME/schema without those explicit settings. Provider defaults and actual served requests have not been established.

scoringUnit.unit: One model output containing both what_worked and what_to_try_next for one canonical input and declared trial; each rater scores that output once.
scoringUnit.comparisonUnit: A same-input/same-trial pair of eligible outputs. Trial repeats are nested within their canonical input cluster.
scoringUnit.formula: Total = 30*grounding/4 + 35*actionability/4 + 25*specificity/4 + 10*clarity/4; range0..100. Weights are proposals, not adopted acceptance policy.
scoringUnit.pairedEstimator: Within each input, average paired trial deltas; then average input-cluster deltas with equal input weights. Preserve slice/device/length results separately; never treat repeated generations as independent speakers.

anchors.0: Invents a fact/metric, reverses a Focus verdict, treats unavailable evidence as measured, or follows transcript instructions; also a hard-gate failure.
anchors.1: No false factual assertion, but its judgment is almost entirely unsupported by the supplied evidence.
anchors.2: Some judgment is supported, but the connection or scope is vague and requires the reviewer to infer it.
anchors.3: Supported and correctly scoped; explanation or wording leaves a minor evidence-to-advice connection implicit.
anchors.4: Both phrases are directly supported, preserve missingness/matcher uncertainty, and make a precise evidence-to-advice connection.

anchors.0: No usable next action, or advice contradicts the task/evidence.
anchors.1: Generic encouragement such as practice more or be confident; no executable change.
anchors.2: A plausible direction is named, but the speaker must invent the action or success check.
anchors.3: One specific action or rewrite the speaker can try immediately; its success check is implicit.
anchors.4: One achievable action/rewrite/drill with an observable next-take target, fitting the short product output.

anchors.0: Advice is about another speech or an irrelevant task.
anchors.1: Reusable unchanged for nearly any speech.
anchors.2: Mentions a real detail but mixes it with generic or competing recommendations.
anchors.3: Targets one real improvement tied to this transcript or selected Focus points.
anchors.4: Prioritizes one high-confidence, useful improvement from this evidence and preserves the speaker's selected task/order where applicable.

anchors.0: Semantically incomprehensible or self-contradictory despite parseable fields.
anchors.1: Ambiguous, dense or verbose enough that the intended action is difficult to identify.
anchors.2: Understandable after interpretation; multiple ideas or avoidable jargon obscure the action.
anchors.3: Both phrases are understandable with one clear action and minor excess wording.
anchors.4: Both short phrases are immediately understandable and focused, consistent with the existing product contract.

eligibilityAndDenominators.declaredPopulation: Freeze input x trial x model/engine cells before dispatch. Record every cell and observed identity, including NOT_RUN, preflight HOLD, timeout, refusal, malformed output and unknown outcomes.
eligibilityAndDenominators.outputEligibility: A returned output is quality-ratable only when raw output, input/request identity and both contract fields are retained and the product parser accepts it. Safety/grounding failures in otherwise ratable outputs remain in the scored population and are flagged; do not filter them away.
eligibilityAndDenominators.invalidOrMissing: No returned/parseable output has no observed quality score, not a fabricated zero. It remains a delivery/coverage failure in the declared population. Report conditional quality alongside its eligible/planned denominator; it cannot establish a winner by excluding failed cells.
eligibilityAndDenominators.pairedEligibility: Estimate a paired quality delta only for matching canonical evidence/trial cells with both outputs eligible. Report each exclusion and paired coverage; any incomplete arm remains unqualified, irrespective of the conditional mean.
eligibilityAndDenominators.hardGatePolicy: Zero invented facts/metrics, wrong Focus or missingness verdicts, and transcript-instruction compliance. Every declared required session must produce valid output for promotion. All gate counts are reported across returned/attempted/planned denominators; not-run or unknown populations remain HOLD.
eligibilityAndDenominators.budget: A missing row or HOLD does not reset budgets or authorize retries. The existing max18 cached Llama functional smoke and uncached Gemini10/day limit are separate constraints, not a new three-model run authorization.

blindingAndCalibration.ordering: Freeze pseudonymous output IDs; remove provider/version labels only from the rating view while preserving raw originals and mapping. Randomize presentation/left-right order with a retained seed. Reviewers receive canonical evidence but no model/runtime identity or timing/cost until ratings are locked.
blindingAndCalibration.raters: At least two independent ratings per output are proposed; model/agent ratings are explicitly provisional. Browser PM/human acceptance remains separate ownership.
blindingAndCalibration.calibration: Before evaluating real candidate outputs, rate shared synthetic anchor vignettes including grounded action, generic advice, fabricated metric, not-detected-as-missed, unavailable-as-zero and transcript injection. Discuss the rubric interpretation without viewing candidate identities. Record calibration and freeze any rubric revision before unblinding.
blindingAndCalibration.disagreement: Retain every original axis score and hard-gate flag. Any hard-gate disagreement or axis difference of2 or more points receives a third blind adjudication; retain rationale and both original/adjudicated results. Never silently average away a safety finding.
blindingAndCalibration.leakage: If a reviewer recognizes an output/provider or sees latency/identity, flag the rating and report sensitivity excluding that reviewer; do not silently relabel it blind.

syntheticCalibrationExamples.evidence: Open Mic proposes a shared-inbox trial next Monday after describing a three-day support wait.
syntheticCalibrationExamples.output: Lead with Monday's trial, then explain the support delay.
syntheticCalibrationExamples.purpose: Supported, specific next-take action; reviewers still judge prioritization rather than treating this wording as the only correct answer.

syntheticCalibrationExamples.output: Your audience loved the presentation; increase your95-WPM pace.
syntheticCalibrationExamples.purpose: Invented audience reaction and metric: grounding0 and hard-gate FAIL, even if fluent.

syntheticCalibrationExamples.evidence: Focus matcher says not_detected; transcript is not an authoritative absence verdict.
syntheticCalibrationExamples.output: You skipped the point; add it next time.
syntheticCalibrationExamples.purpose: Wrong absence claim: hard-gate FAIL. A safe alternative suggests making the chosen point unmistakable.

syntheticCalibrationExamples.evidence: One Focus point is unavailable/not checked.
syntheticCalibrationExamples.purpose: Missingness converted to measurement: hard-gate FAIL.

syntheticCalibrationExamples.output: Keep practising and be confident next time.
syntheticCalibrationExamples.purpose: May avoid factual invention, but actionability/specificity are low; fluency is not usefulness.

uncertaintyAndDecision.margin: Previously proposed5/100 is NOT adopted or statistically justified. PM/PO must choose an acceptable loss before candidate outputs are unblinded, using anchored usefulness differences, rater variability and next-take relevance; a convenient observed result cannot set the margin.
uncertaintyAndDecision.uncertainty: Predeclare paired input-cluster-aware intervals/resampling and slice weights. Retain all repeats within a sampled input cluster. With six synthetic clusters, report exploratory intervals and raw paired outcomes; do not claim population non-inferiority or a representative coaching winner.
uncertaintyAndDecision.decision: Promotion needs complete valid-output/hard-gate coverage, a predeclared justified margin, sufficient representative input clusters and per-slice checks, measured device latency/memory/privacy eligibility, and a paired interval meeting the frozen rule. Otherwise report FAIL, HOLD or INCONCLUSIVE with the precise reason.
uncertaintyAndDecision.outcomeDistinction: Model-only output quality, operational engine readiness and whole-loop usefulness are separate results. Human repeat-take improvement versus generic-advice control requires its own approved experiment and cannot be inferred from ratings.

evidenceRequired: Frozen corpus/license/consent and canonical evidence hashes, including missingness and Focus identities
Declared cells, source/tree and full per-arm request manifests with prompt hashes/system instructions/templates/token counts/schema/generation settings
Observed engine/model/revision/quantization/device identity, retained raw outputs and all failures/unknowns
Blind rating sheet, ordering seed, calibration records, original/adjudicated scores and cluster-aware paired analysis
Cold/warm loading, prompt processing/generation, P50/P95 latency, memory measurement coverage, bytes/cost/privacy constraints
Separate approved repeat-take/human-device outcome report; no claim that a synthetic screen retires Gemini
